title: Proclamation S.I. 1998, No. 106 of August 11, 1998 of the Copyright Act, 1998 (Act 1998-4)
text:
Collection of Laws for Electronic Access BARBADOS
YH
Proclamation S.I. 1998, No. 106 of August 11, 1998 of the
Copyright Act, 1998 (Act 1998-4)
S.I. 1998 No. 106
By His Excellency Sir Clifford Straughn Husbands, Knight Grand Cross of the Most
Distinguished Order of Saint Michael and Saint George, Knight of St. Andrew,
Governor-General of Barbados
C. Straughn Husbands
Governor-General
A Proclamation
Whereas by section 152 of the Copyright Act, 1998 (Act 1998-4) it is provided that the
said Act shall come into operation on a date to be fixed by proclamation:
And whereas it is expedient that the said Act shall come into operation on the 14th day
of August, 1998.
Now therefore by virtue of the power and authority in me vested, I hereby appoint the
14th day of August, 1998 as the day on which the said Act shall come into operation.
Given under my hand and the Public Seal of Barbados this 11th day of August, 1998
and in the forty-seventh year of Her Majesty’s reign.
BB032EN Copyright (Act 1998-4), Proclamation (Commencement), page 1/1
11/08/1998, No. 4
